title: upscayl/upscayl: local open-source AI image enlargement
friendlyTitle: Upscayl enlarges images with AI on your own computer
summary: Upscayl is a desktop application that uses AI models to enlarge and enhance images locally on Linux, macOS and Windows. The established open-source project has nearly 50,000 stars and gained about 177 stars in today’s GitHub Trending collection.
friendlySummary: Upscayl is a free desktop app for making small images larger on Linux, Mac and Windows. It was among today’s most popular AI-related GitHub projects.
whyItMatters: People can improve low-resolution scans, artwork or product images without uploading the originals to a hosted editing service. Results depend on the source and model, so compare the output at full size and keep the untouched original when factual detail matters.
friendlyWhyItMatters: You can improve an image without sending it to an online service. Keep the original because AI enlargement can invent or change small details.
